metadata.description: Complete Antardasha effects for Vimshottari Dasha system (9 Mahadashas × 9 Antardashas)
metadata.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (BPHS), Phaladeepika, Jataka Bharatiya
metadata.bphs_ref: Ch.54-62 - Antardasha Effects by Mahadasha Lord

friend_friend.effects: Enhanced positive effects, mutual cooperation, beneficial outcomes amplified

friend_neutral.effects: Positive effects with some neutral periods, generally favorable

friend_enemy.effects: Mixed results with conflicts and reconciliations, unstable period

neutral_neutral.effects: Balanced effects, neither strongly positive nor negative

enemy_enemy.effects: Challenging period with obstacles and suffering, difficult circumstances

enemy_neutral.effects: Difficult period with some relief, obstacles gradually decrease

duration_calculation.explanation: In Vimshottari Dasha, the cycle is 120 years total. Antardasha duration is calculated proportionally.

interpretation_guidelines.combined_effects: Antardasha effects are modified by Mahadasha lord. A benefic antardasha in malefic Mahadasha shows some relief, while malefic in benefic causes temporary setbacks.
interpretation_guidelines.planetary_friendship: Friend planets enhance cooperation. Enemy planets create conflict. Neutral planets provide balance.
interpretation_guidelines.strength_assessment: Consider both planets' positions in birth chart, aspects, and current transit conditions when assessing intensity.
interpretation_guidelines.remedial_measures: Mantra, charity, and worship of antardasha lord can mitigate negative effects and enhance positive ones.
interpretation_guidelines.planning: Important life decisions best made when antardasha supports the area of life involved.
